comments.text: 2026-10-04: the human tested the interactive demo (spikes/voice-moonshine-a2000f, npm 0.1.5, Tiny, 2 threads) on a real microphone in their own browser and it transcribed and routed speech correctly. A headless probe through Chromium's fake mic also routes all fixture lines; mic open about 2 s after the model is cached. Still open: 60-minute run, background tab, battery.
